what: Likely a coordinated civic appreciation presentation in the town hall great hall at 18:00, with bread, supplies and arrangements involving local tradespeople. Its existence and stated subject were disclosed in the appointment supplement, but its contents are deliberately private and I am asked not to arrive early. Secretary knowingly manages timing and secrecy; neighbour appears involved through bakery discussions, though their precise role is uncertain. Reports of a bridge or port change are unverified and do not establish that as the actual project.
